partner_result_applied.application: After a uniform conditional three-coordinate density cap is proved, its L1_z(Linfinity_u) shear theorem adds the entire outside Schur quadratic with no independence assumption.

new_results.statement: If an original physical triple I has a pivot a=A_ii!=0 and det A[I,I]!=0, then the full ambient quadratic form has essential density cap 128 |a det A[I,I]|^(-1/4), uniformly over every outside block and cross coupling.

If a protected 3x3 core M0 has pivot a0 and sigma_min sigma0, while its final compression changes by op norm delta<min(|a0|,sigma0), then density <=128[(|a0|-delta)(sigma0-delta)^3]^(-1/4), with all outside entries unrestricted.
